boundaries.areaCells: Every entered-area sample is polygon-clipped against unit cells; any partial cell other than a whole or half, unknown checkSpec, or source/native answer mismatch fails.

boundaries.graphicFills: Every allowed native partition candidate and fill type is enumerated. The reader uses the actual boolean fills and validates their sum against the native fraction.
